Visitor replaces horizontal rule with custom output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitHorizontalRule(NodeContext ctx) {        return new VisitResult.Custom("\n[DIVIDER]\n");    }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<h1>Section A</h1><p>Content A</p><hr><h1>Section B</h1><p>Content B</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
